subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` change its default ambiguous-disconnect behavior from an automatic fresh embedded fallback to a fail-closed recovery error, with rerun available only through `--rerun-on-ambiguous`?
rationale: Both paths are defensible: fail-closed avoids duplicate tool and delivery effects, while the current fallback preserves the historical expectation that the CLI returns a result. This is a public CLI compatibility choice, not a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
options.body: Adopt reattach-first and make a fresh rerun explicit, after real evidence confirms the recovered, terminal-failure, cache-miss, and delivery paths.

options.title: Retain automatic fallback
options.body: Keep the current fresh-session fallback as the default and treat reattach recovery as an additive or opt-in enhancement.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
recommendation.body: Adopt reattach-first and make a fresh rerun explicit, after real evidence confirms the recovered, terminal-failure, cache-miss, and delivery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The current automatic fresh-session fallback was introduced by this owner path, making them the strongest history-based routing candidate for its replacement contract.
